notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed many visual bugs (text being wrong size and text bubble being in wrong places)

Fixed bug preventing progress past a certain slot machine

Fixed bug preventing players from buying packages

All changes appear to be fixed on my end need more user testing to be sure, so please let me know if you find any bugs.

notes.title: Patch notes V1.1
notes.content:
Fixed:

Bug preventing players from beating game

Missing file resulting in null value and image

text not resizing with textbox (still need more user testing)

Bug when buying packages (Might have been fixed by adding the missing files, needs more user testing)

Known but not fixed yet:

Minor bugs when returning to main menu and then starting a new game (I have tried 15 times to fix this will figure it out eventually, not game breaking mainly visual)

With the exception of the known but not fixed bug, I was made aware of these bugs today and have implemented a patch.  I have not tested the changes on mac (I don't own one, but I should be able to get someone to test it soon)

If you notice any bugs please let me know so I can continue to improve this game!

notes.title: Future updates
notes.content:
I have put a lot of thought into what update I should work on first.  I plan on adding all of these features, but am not sure what order would be best.  I've listed them in order of likelihood to be done first.

- Add background images to each slot machine, such as a witch on the witch slots

- More cards and items (I have a list of items and cards that were never implemented but would love to know if anyone has suggestions)

- Custom runs (not just setting the pay costs and number of spins, but also adding your own cards and items)

- Balancing (I need user feedback, but I'm assuming most people haven't unlocked everything)

Please let me know if you have any suggestions and if you want to see any of these features more than others.

P.S.

Try godmode click the person hiding 27 times

Also Thank you to everyone who has bought the game.  I spent around 3 months making it and I plan on making it better.
